title: API endpoint with tests
prompt: In app.py write handle(method, path, body=None) -> (status, dict). `body` defaults to None and must be optional, since GET calls pass only method and path. POST /items with {'name': str} returns 201 and {'id': int, 'name': str}. GET /items returns 200 and {'items': [...]}. A name that is missing, not a string, empty, or all whitespace (e.g. '   ') all return 400. Unknown path returns 404. Add tests in test_app.py.
